reasoning: The icon depicts a 90-degree bent arrow going up and turning right, standard for 'turn right' in navigation or 'forward / redirect' in digital interfaces. While mostly UI chrome, it serves as a decent action icon for tasks explicitly about forwarding emails/mail, setting up URL/call redirects, or port forwarding, though an envelope-with-arrow is usually clearer for mail.
